entities.name: Napoleon Bonaparte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: French military commander and Emperor (1769–1821) who rose from Corsican obscurity to dominate European politics for two decades. His military genius — particularly the use of massed artillery and rapid maneuver — won over 60 battles. The Napoleonic Code he imposed became the basis for civil law systems worldwide, yet his imperial ambitions cost millions of lives.
